name: Fusion EMS
old_description: Fusion specializes in turnkey and consigned EMS strategies, with a focus on high-mix, low-to-medium and high-volume production. We leverage deep expertise and a wide range of capabilities to develop custom solutions for our customers, and support your program every step of the way.
about:
Based in Hillsboro, Oregon, Fusion EMS has spent three decades providing electronics manufacturing services. The company focuses on turnkey and consigned EMS strategies, serving customers with high-mix, low-to-medium and high-volume production needs.

Fusion EMS offers a broad range of manufacturing capabilities, including PCB assembly, surface mount technology, conformal coating and potting, and test development. The company supports programs from new product introduction and quick-turn prototyping through box-build assembly, final packaging, and component purchasing with per-customer inventory management. Its processes emphasize robust engineering reviews, supplier input, and alternate component sourcing.

The company serves aerospace, medical and life sciences, industrial, and military and defense markets. Customers in these sectors rely on Fusion EMS for high-reliability electronic assemblies that meet stringent regulatory and quality requirements.

Fusion EMS differentiates itself by leveraging deep expertise and a wide range of capabilities to develop custom solutions, supporting customer programs at every step. All production personnel are trained and certified to IPC Class III standards, and the facility employs SPC and DMAIC principles to ensure product and process quality.
